messages.marker: [message:001] The user-visible shared-chat checkpoint set the work order as: `1. docs/V6_LOCKED_PLAN.md 2. issue #9 3. inspect #2 / agent/swe-foundation 4. continue #2 → #3 → #4/#7 5. then expand/plan #10–#19`.
[message:002] The rendered response treated `docs/V6_LOCKED_PLAN.md` and Issue #9 as the durable architecture handoff, recorded through documentation PR #20.
[message:003] The rendered response ordered the first implementation path through #2 / PR #21 for the ordinary SWE foundation and #3 / PR #22 for one minimal walking skeleton.
[message:004] The rendered response placed #4 / PR #23 and #7 / PR #24 after the walking skeleton as the V4 stable-state/context and SCC-v2 adversarial-regression branches.
[message:005] The rendered response held #10–#19 as later execution packets rather than immediate implementation scope.
[message:006] The rendered response gave the intended integration order as #21, then #22, then the #23 and #24 siblings.
